proposals.before: At the time there was Zhang Shu, an elder of Jinhua in Wu prefecture, who likewise refused repeated summons.
proposals.after: At the time there was Zhang Shu, courtesy name Zichang, a man of Jinhua in Wu prefecture, who likewise refused repeated summons.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張樞子長 follows the name-plus-courtesy pattern; 子長 is courtesy name Zichang, not the English noun "elder".

proposals.before: He bound the slaves and jailed them; the son, hiding elsewhere, was captured and, as a close kinsman of the general, received a reduced sentence short of death.
proposals.after: He bound the slaves and jailed them; the son, hiding elsewhere, was captured and, because of near kinship (近族), received a reduced sentence short of death.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic invents "as a close kinsman of the general"; Chinese 近族 more naturally marks near imperial/clan kinship without specifying the general.

decisions.reason: s0088 張樞子長者 uses the standard personal-name plus courtesy-name pattern; 子長 is Zichang, not "elder," and 婺之金華人 supports "a man of Jinhua in Wu prefecture."

sourceWitness.excerpt: 張樞子長者，婺之金華人

decisions.after: He bound the slaves and jailed them; the son, hiding elsewhere, was captured and, because of near kinship, received a reduced sentence short of death.
decisions.reason: s0054 以近族得減死論 gives only near kinship as the ground for a reduced death sentence and does not name the general; the original invents "of the general," but the proposed idiomatic is awkward for inserting Chinese 近族 in parentheses.
